title: fix(cli): os init -t app places its item fields through the group's fields list, as os g object does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoXUKHVN4Zz5ysxe9AmF99Nv)_

Fixes #37615

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 新建应用项目的开发者用命令行模板建项目后，示例对象里字段归入「详情」分组的写法，和生成对象命令、新手模板现在是同一种；页面上显示的分组不变。
- 属于「新手只遇到一种写法」这条线：之前命令行还在教另一种写法，照抄的人和编程助手会学到两套。
- 只改新项目生成出来的示例文件，已有项目不受影响；有问题直接撤回即可。
- 无

## What changes
- `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`, the `app` template's `src/objects/__name___item.object.ts`: the item's three fields (`name`, `description`, `status`) no longer carry `group: 'details'`. The `details` field group moves after the field map and lists them itself: `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'details', label: 'Details', fields: ['name', 'description', 'status'] }]`. That is the placement `os g object` writes since PR #37595 and the `npm create objectstack` starter uses (#32153). The comment above it now says to list each new field in a section, in the words `os g object`'s scaffold uses.
- `export default` and everything else in the file are unchanged; the template's app and list view still default-import the item.
- Both spellings mean the same placement, so the form and detail page draw the same Details section, and `field-no-consumers` credits a field placed either way (since #36945).
- `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/cli`.
- Item 2 of the card (the "18.6.0 today" callouts) is not in this PR: it waits for `create-objectstack` 19.x on npm's `latest` tag and moved to its own on-hold card, #38159, per the claim.

## Tests
- New `packages/cli/test/init-item-field-placement.test.ts`: renders the template's item object and pins (1) no per-field `group:` line, and (2) the `details` group's `fields` list names exactly the declared fields, in order, and sits after the field map.

<details><summary>Readings at 1e34fc99 (base origin/main 581ae76a)</summary>

- Premise at 581ae76a: `git grep -n "group: 'details'" -- packages/cli/src` → 3 hits, all `init.ts` (1080, 1084, 1094); `generate.ts:353-354` already writes the `fields` list.
- New pin: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 2 passed (2)`. Ablation: `init.ts` restored to 581ae76a with the pin in place → `Tests 2 failed (2)`, both tests red; fix restored after.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project (`vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock): `Test Files 447 passed (447)`, `Tests 6419 passed (6419)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Integration layer for this surface, run locally on the probe (same `init.ts` bytes): `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` `starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts` + `generate-scaffold-gates.e2e.test.ts` → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 73 passed (73)` (real `os init -t app`, then `os validate` / `os lint`, with the strip-the-placement control). The rest of the integration layer is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at 1e34fc99: 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` first answered exit 3 (prerequisite: pinned commit / package builds) and exit 0 once those were in place.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, 0 open PR heads touch the changed files.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- Other per-field `group: 'details'` sites in the tree (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/semantic-zoo.object.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol` test fixtures) are not newcomer scaffolds and are left as they are.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `init.ts`: the item object template, around the `fieldGroups` block after `fields`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/init-item-field-placement.test.ts` passes; put `init.ts` back to 581ae76a and both tests turn red.
